target: retrospective timing-marginal transfer of released apparatus templates; not neutron decay rate or ARK validation
unit: microseconds relative to trap opening; no energy mapping
bin_convention: left inclusive, right exclusive; arithmetic edges rounded to 9 decimals
per_run_allowed_information: early-window sum and late-baseline sum; their two linear constraints set template scale and additive offset. These are measured inputs, not target-tail fits.
template_model: mu_j=A_r S_r,j(delta)+B_r; S integrated as piecewise-constant histogram under common time translation; boundary extension uses released late-bin mean. No spectrum smoothing, clipping or mixing-fraction fitting.
offset_constraint: A positive; B may be signed to remove/add the released template pedestal; every expected count must stay positive. B is not interpreted as a physical negative background.
delta_calibration: One common shift in [-1.2,1.2] us minimizes early-window Poisson deviance for 538 and 537 after solving A,B from two control sums. Grid 97 points then bounded local refinement; record boundaries and flatness. Nominal shift=0 is a mandatory comparator.
primary_metrics: tail observed count versus control-normalized prediction
absolute tail-bin residual per early-bin count
maximum tail cumulative discrepancy per early-bin count
descriptive counting-noise quadratic form with control normalization covariance
uncertainty_scope: Poisson event-count approximation for illustrative count uncertainty only. Cycle correlations, calibration systematics and finite simulation uncertainty unavailable. No formal p-value or sigma-discovery interpretation.
sensitivity: coarsen adjacent bins from 0.6 to 1.2 us
missing_channel_policy: Use all finite times including the 1061 Series527 rows without energy. This is a timing marginal, not a complete-case or energy-selected analysis. Report complete versus missing-energy timing summaries separately; do not assert missing at random.
holdout_policy: Full 527/531 timing distributions not used to choose global shift or windows. Their early and baseline counts ARE normalization inputs. Tail results are not purely external predictions. Published trends and source template's fitted voltage offset/3% composition already known: retrospective, not blind.
selection: No energy cut. Report outside-range triggers. No acquisition row interpreted as chronology, no event count as neutron exposure.
model_revision_policy: Freeze this file. Preserve failed comparisons. Post-outcome alternatives must be explicitly new analyses; no retuning the primary target windows, background or mixture.
pre_run_access: Repository contract and handoff; public methods HTML; ZIP integrity; simulation grid/content; acquisition headers/counts; no measured spectra inspected in this turn before this file was written. Previous IC13 scanned rows for schema.
